title: Demand Planner
description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc., has an opening in its Anderson, SC office for a Demand Planner that is responsible for maintaining an accurate Production, Sales, and Inventory Plan to support company and customer expectations within acceptable inventory targets.

We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package -- tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation and holidays.

Scope

This position will define inventory targets and purchasing needs to support company sales while exceeding service level and turns targets. Demand Planners work closely with multiple associates across the supply chain to ensure expectations are clearly defined, including:

• Sales managers, product development teams, supervisor and customer to capture best collaborative forecast

• Factory teams to ensure expectations are clearly defined and that goods ship on time while managing inventory within budget requirements.

• Purchasing to ensure factory purchase orders are aligned to timing needs

• Customers to align retail sales expectations, assist with the containerization of direct flow goods, and address opportunities

• Distribution to make sure orders are shipping timely and event expectations are communicated.

Primary Responsibilities

Demand Planners maintain a PSI (Production, Sales, and Inventory Plan), improve processes, exceed company service level expectations, and define opportunities to reduce costs.

• Define inventory needs to support customer replenishment and event execution

• Obtain, analyze and interpret supply chain relevant data from multiple sources

• Define factory orders to ensure an adequate supply of finished product for required forecasted demand

• Coordinate receiving priorities and order exceptions with Distribution

• Maintain reports critical to business function, including financial forecast, inventory projections, and service performance

• Schedule regular meetings and report out all potential supply chain failures and opportunities

• Capture failures, root cause, corrective action, and document accountability

• Address customer emergencies and manage through to resolve

• Assist with Customer Compliancy Disputes

• Build relationships throughout supply chain to recognize and address process improvement opportunities

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Operations, or related field preferred OR equivalent experience.

• Minimum 2 years  of Supply Chain experience

• Well versed in Microsoft Office Suite applications with advanced Excel skills

• Demonstrate statistical, analytical and mathematical aptitude

title: Electrical Engineer II - Embedded Hardware
description:
Job Description:

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

The Electrical Engineer II will independently design, prototype, test, and troubleshoot embedded electronic systems for low- to mid-complexity projects. This role will collaborate with global engineering teams, product managers, test engineering, and suppliers to deliver robust, cost-effective, and manufacturable designs. The engineer will apply platform and reuse principles, make data-driven technical decisions, and support platform designs from concept through qualification and release.

You'll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:

• Independently design, prototype, test, and troubleshoot embedded electronic hardware and supporting firmware for low- to mid-complexity product and platform projects.

• Develop analog and digital circuits that may include microcontrollers, power supplies, sensors, communication interfaces, protection circuits, and signal-conditioning functions.

• Create and review schematics, support PCB layout, perform circuit simulations, and apply sound design practices for signal integrity, noise, reliability, cost, and manufacturability.

• Develop engineering requirements, test plans, procedures, and test cases for electronic components, printed circuit board assemblies, subsystems, and complete electronics platforms.

• Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, data-acquisition systems, power analyzers, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, and protocol analyzers as applicable.

• Conduct experiments, analyze data using appropriate statistical methods, document results, and draw concise, logical conclusions that guide design decisions.

• Perform root-cause analysis and resolve hardware, firmware-interaction, test, and platform integration issues with urgency and disciplined problem solving.

• Evaluate technical tradeoffs and recommend solutions that balance performance, user needs, schedule, cost, reliability, regulatory compliance, and reuse capability.

• Collaborate with component suppliers and manufacturing partners to select components, address availability or quality concerns, and support successful platform launches.

• Work with cross-functional and global teams to incorporate platform-based design approaches and reusable technical solutions across product categories.

• Track assigned work to project schedules, surface risks early, and communicate status, decisions, and recommendations to technical teams and management.

• Prepare agendas, facilitate technical reviews, document decisions and action items, and deliver clear presentations to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and technicians while modeling Milwaukee Tool culture and engineering best practices.

• Build and maintain knowledge of Milwaukee Tool development and manufacturing processes to support efficient, high-quality designs.

• Support design qualification to applicable safety, EMC, wireless, and product standards based on the scope of the design.

What TOOLS you'll bring with you:

• Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• 2+ years of experience in electrical or embedded hardware design, development, validation, or a closely related engineering role.

• Working knowledge of embedded systems, analog and digital circuit design, PCBA design and manufacturing, and electronics verification and validation fundamentals.

• Experience with schematic-capture, PCB-layout, and circuit-simulation tools.

• Ability to select components, review datasheets, perform engineering calculations, and translate system needs into component- and circuit-level requirements.

• Experience using standard electronics laboratory equipment and applying structured troubleshooting methods.

• Working knowledge of C programming for microcontrollers and the interaction between firmware and electronics.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document work and explain technical tradeoffs.

• Excellent problem-solving skills, sound independent judgment, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

• Self-motivated, organized, efficient, process-oriented, and committed to high-quality engineering work.

• Ability to travel up to 10% of the time, domestically and internationally.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:

• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience with embedded communications, Bluetooth Low Energy, wired serial interfaces, antenna or RF circuits, or low-power electronic design.

• Knowledge of firmware development tools and an additional programming language such as Python or C++.

• Experience with design of experiments, automated test development, data acquisition, or statistical analysis.

• Knowledge of electronic component reliability, failure modes, design for manufacturability, and design for test.

• Familiarity with applicable regulatory and certification standards such as UL, FCC, ISED/IC, CE, CEC, or ANSI.

• Hands-on experience with soldering, rework, prototype assembly, and test-fixture development.

We provide these great perks and benefits:

• Robust health, dental, and vision insurance plans.

• Generous 401(k) savings plan.

• Education assistance.

• On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.

Field Sales and Marketing Representative – Techtronic Industries, NA (TTI)

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

·          Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

·          Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.

·          Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

·          Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

·          Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.

·          Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

·          Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

·          Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

·          Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

·          Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

·          Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

·          Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

·          Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

·          Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

·          Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

·          Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

·          Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

·          Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

·          Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

·          Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

·          Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

·          Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

·          Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

·          The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

·          Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

·          Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

·          Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)

• The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

• Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year

• Company iPhone and iPad

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

• Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more

• 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)

• Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)

• Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date

• Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business

• Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

Job Postings are available for at least 48 hours from the posting date. TTI accepts ongoing applications and will evaluate based on the needs of the business.

Locations available Nationwide. To learn more about TTI, visit our website at www.ttirecruiting.com.

• Self-motivated, organized, efficient, process oriented with a strong work ethic.

• Exceptional verbal and writing skills.

• Ability to travel 10% of the time (domestic and international).

• Master’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

• Experience with CAD tools, particularly those relevant to electrical/PCB design.

• “Bare metal” C/C++ programming experience outside of an OS/RTOS.

• Experience developing bare-metal firmware designs for real-time applications.

title: Sr Advanced Quality Engineer - Fall Protection
description:
Job Description:

Come be DISRUPTIVE with us! At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees - employees who work with a passion to be the best and an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one.

All our teams touch every step of the process, that is why our Engineering teams are some of the key contributors to our continuous innovations. The fast-paced, agile environment continuously delivers disruptive technologies by providing every team with the resources needed to excel and working directly with End Users to understand how to deliver heavy-duty products with high performance. We create Best-in-class products by leveraging advanced analysis tools, extensive testing regimes, state-of-the-art manufacturing processes and cross-functional agility.

The Sr. Advanced Quality Engineer – Fall Protection provides quality and reliability engineering leadership to cross-functional project teams developing and manufacturing occupational fall-protection products. The AQE directly interfaces with New Product Development, Product Support, and Value Engineering teams. Primary duties are to lead and direct the quality activities of project teams to successfully meet Project Quality Objectives as well as project goals including Time-To-Market, Cost, and Performance for this highly regulated and safety critical category.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Serve as the Sr. Team lead for the Quality and Reliability function while supporting process improvement initiatives.

Reliability Functions:

• Collaborate with Engineering, Marketing, and Regulatory teams to translate customer needs and regulatory requirements into product performance and design specifications.

• Apply robust understanding of OSHA, ANSI/ASSP, and EN regulatory compliance ensuring critical safety products protect end users and meet all applicable regulations.

• Support the product design process including benchmarking and testing of concepts & prototypes.

• Develop and execute risk-based test procedures to validate product specifications and ensure Quality and Reliability readiness.

• Lead Risk Assessments (Design and Manufacturing) during the product development cycle.

• Draw concise, logical, written conclusions from experiments based on data analysis

• Perform failure analysis and recommend solutions with corrective action, as required.

• Proactively seek out quality improvements for new and existing products.

Quality Functions - New Product team:

• Work with global operations, materials, manufacturing engineering, and quality engineering teams to develop QC mitigation strategies for high-risk specifications.

• Establish Critical to Quality (CTQ) characteristics and controls for high strength textile-based products.

• Provide technical guidance to develop manufacturing, inspection, and testing requirements for safety critical products with various teams at both internal and supplier facilities.

• Lead supplier evaluation, process qualification, capability assessment, manufacturing readiness, and quality planning for global suppliers and manufacturing sites

• Collaborate with US, European, and Asian based manufacturing and supplier representatives to ensure operational readiness of new product launches.

• Participate in the evaluation and selection of suppliers.

• Able to call, lead and conduct global, cross functional team members with the following participants: New product development engineering, internal/external operations/suppliers, quality and supply chain.

Requirements:

Master’s or equivalent degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing/Production, Materials Engineering or related engineering field and 2 years of relevant experience or Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing/Production, Materials Engineering or related engineering field and 5 years of relevant experience.  Experience must include:

• Regulated new product development environment.

• Research and development with soft goods, natural or synthetic materials that are flexible including but not limited to textiles, foams, rubber, films or equivalent.

• Manufacturing quality experience in a regulated product field

• Test development and execution experience in a regulated product field

• Engineering tools such as Critical to Quality/Quality Function Deployment, Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T), Statistical Process Control (SPC), Design of Experiments (DOE), Control Plans, Risk Analysis through Failure Modes Effects Analysis (FMEA) and metrology methods

• Statistical tools such as MiniTab

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Materials Operator
description:
Job Description:

Your Role on Our Team

At Milwaukee Tool, we are committed to delivering high-quality, innovative solutions to our users. The Material Operator plays a critical role in supporting manufacturing operations by ensuring the safe, accurate, and efficient flow of materials throughout the facility. This position is responsible for receiving, storing, moving, stocking, and shipping materials while maintaining inventory accuracy and supporting uninterrupted production. The role focuses on safety, operational efficiency, and system accuracy in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities

• Consistently demonstrates safety first mindset; follows all safety related processes and procedures, quickly escalates safety related concerns or issues to create a safe work environment for all employees.

• Safely and efficiently operate material handling equipment, including forklifts, high-reach trucks (up to 30 feet), and swing-reach trucks, while meeting productivity, quality, and safety standards.

• Load and unload trailers, containers, and transportation vehicles safely, efficiently, and in compliance with established procedures.

• Maintain work area per 6s facility standards without direction.

• Execute material handling activities based on operational requirements, which may include equipment operation, production line replenishment, container unloading, shipping support, or a combination of warehouse and production support functions.

• Receive inbound shipments, verify materials against receiving documentation, and accurately transfer inventory to designated storage locations in accordance with established procedures.

• Store, stack, and organize raw materials, components, and finished goods to maximize safety, space utilization, and operational efficiency.

• Ensure continuous production flow by timely replenishment of materials and components at assembly and manufacturing workstations.

• Transport finished goods from production areas to designated staging, warehouse, or shipping locations in a safe and efficient manner.

• Return excess, unused, or recovered materials to appropriate inventory locations and complete all required inventory transactions accurately.

• Pick, prepare, stage, load, and ship customer orders while verifying product accuracy, quantities, and shipping destinations.

• Maintain accurate inventory records through timely system transactions and proper documentation of material movements to support inventory integrity and ERP system accuracy.

• Perform daily equipment inspections, maintain required operating and safety logs, and adhere to all company safety, quality, and operational policies and procedures.

• Support warehouse and production team objectives through flexibility, teamwork, and effective communication across departments.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance safety, efficiency, accuracy, and overall operational performance.

• Assist with cycle counts, physical inventories, and inventory reconciliation activities as assigned.

• Must be able to work unsupervised and handle multiple tasks.

• Collaborate with production, warehouse, quality, and shipping teams to ensure materials are available and moved efficiently throughout the operation.

• Ability to work overtime with advanced or little notice.

• All other duties as assigned.

The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:

Job Description:

About Us:

TTI (Techtronic Industries) is a fast-paced, high energy, organization that rewards out-of-the-box thinking to foster innovation allowing us to be the best in our industry. We provide a multi-faceted training program and hands-on field experience that will stimulate, challenge, and reward you.

TTI is a world-class leader in design, manufacturing and marketing of power tools and accessories, outdoor product equipment, and floor care products. Our consumers range from professional and industrial users in the home improvement, repair, and construction industries to homeowners & DIY enthusiasts. Our unrelenting strategic focus on powerful brands, innovative products, operational excellence, and exceptional people drives our culture. This focus and drive provide TTI with a powerful platform for sustainable leadership and strong growth.

Our brands and products are recognized worldwide for their deep heritage, superior quality, outstanding performance, and compelling innovation. Our products include professional power tools and accessories, outdoor power equipment, and floor care. Our brands include Milwaukee®, AEG®, Ryobi®, Oreck®, Hoover®, Dirt Devil® and Vax®.

In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in driving market share growth and maintaining TTI’s premier product lines within The Home Depot—our most valued and influential retail partner. You’ll be at the forefront of retail strategy execution, gaining hands-on experience in merchandising, sales analytics, and customer engagement. This position offers a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in our core business operations while accelerating your career in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly rewarding environment. Your contributions will directly impact TTI’s presence in the retail space, positioning you for continued advancement within the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Exceed sales targets by delivering best-in-class Business to Consumer sales and customer service within The Home Depot, engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and recommend tailored TTI product solutions, all while demonstrating deep product knowledge and enthusiasm.

• Plan and execute promotional events, product demos, and store walks to drive consumer engagement and increase product sell-through.

• Support and implement strategic corporate brand marketing initiatives and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive sell-through.

• Ensure brand presence and sales-readiness through strategic merchandising, optimal product placement, and completion of store objectives and resets—leveraging data analytics through Microsoft Power BI to drive decisions and maximize impact.

• Develop a strong understanding of the retail marketplace, including customer profiles, product applications, competitive landscape, and channel dynamics.

• Participate in TTI’s world class training program to be equipped with the knowledge to work independently within your assigned market.

• Build and manage relationships with The Home Depot team members to enhance in-store execution and cultivate long-term business partnerships.

• Effectively manage inventory levels through down-stocking, maintaining product accessibility, and ensure prompt reporting of all tasks and responsibilities.

• Participate in merchandising resets to support TTI’s relentless innovation, ensuring the timely placement of cutting-edge products and solutions that drive growth, competitive advantage, and meet evolving market needs, all while adhering to TTI’s safety protocols.

Note: Employee's duties and responsibilities are not limited by the above. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary by the employee's supervisor. In addition to the basic requirements of the position, all employees are expected to meet the company's goals of continual improvement in the areas of knowledge, skills, processes, and quality.

Job / Employment Requirements:

• Must be at least 21 years of age or older.

• Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship or restrictions.

• Ability to pass drug screening and Motor Vehicle Report screening.

• Must have a valid United States driver’s license for at least one continuous full year in one state.

• Must have a personal vehicle / reliable form of transportation.

• Possess and maintain valid personal vehicle insurance listing you as the primary driver.

• Position requires travel to/ from assigned store location(s) as well as occasional travel for meetings, projects, events, etc. Air travel will be required.

• Employees will also be required to transport a small amount of company property (company devices, demo tools, tool kit, safety supplies).

• Capable of reaching and/or lifting overhead in addition to ascending/descending ladders to move product.

• Capable of lifting and transporting heavy tools (up to 50 lbs.) and requesting assistance as needed.

• Capable of using hands to maneuver small objects, assemble tools and build displays.

• Ability to work nights and weekends – weekends will be required at different points throughout the year.

• Ability to work in a retail environment full time and stand for the duration of the shift, with the exception of meal and rest breaks.

• Applicant should be self-motivated and a team player with strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

• The applicant must be MS Office proficient.

• Multilingual abilities preferred in specific markets depending on business needs.

• Formal higher education preferred but not required – Equivalent experience will be considered.

• Relocation may be required for future promotional opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Salary Non-Exempt Position (Overtime Eligible)

• The pay range for this position is $24.04 and $25.96/hour equating to a Target Annual Salary of $50,000 - $54,000

• Sales Contests and Incentives to Earn Additional Income (In Correlation with Business Needs / Focuses)

• Vehicle Allowance of $400/month equating to a target of $4800/year (pre-taxed) dispersed evenly across the 52 weeks in a year

• Company iPhone and iPad

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Benefits Available

• Insurance Coverages Available such as Short-Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, Basic AD&D, and more

• 401K (Company Matches 50% up to 8% of Employee’s Salary)

• Eligible for up to 10 Paid Holiday (Based on hire date)

• Accrue up to 104 hours of PTO – 1st Year – Based on hire date

• Relocation assistance if moving for the position based on needs of the business

• Employee Referral Bonus Program and other incentive initiatives

title: Project Leader
description:
Job Description:

Project Leader – New Product Development Engineering (OPE)

The Project Leader is accountable for the successful cross-functional delivery of moderate to high-complexity new product development (NPD) programs for outdoor power equipment (OPE). Acting as the primary integrator for the project, this role aligns the team on product requirements and strategy, owns the integrated program plan, and drives closure of gaps related to performance, cost, quality, and schedule. The Project Leader leads through influence, maintains the appropriate level of detail to proactively identify risks, barriers, and decision points, and ensures timely escalation of issues that cannot be resolved within the project team. This role communicates clear, data-driven, and decision-ready recommendations to leadership, enabling effective prioritization and rapid resolution of critical program challenges.

Key Job Functions & Responsibilities

Project Strategy & Scope Ownership

• Owns the coordinated delivery of technical and business objectives, ensuring alignment with both internal and external customer requirements

• Drives convergence of performance, features, cost, schedule, quality, and risk trade-offs.

• Ensures the cross-functional team understands priorities, success criteria, decision rights, and required deliverables.

• Challenges assumptions and identifies opportunities to improve the product, execution plan, and business outcome.

Integrated Execution & Risk Leadership

• Owns the integrated project schedule, critical path, milestone readiness, and operating rhythm across all functions.

• Drives timely closure of cross-functional gaps and escalates constraints when additional authority, resources, or business decisions are required.

• Leads project risk management, including identification, prioritization, mitigation, investment, contingency planning, and decision timing.

• Ensures functional owners maintain credible task-level plans while holding the team accountable for commitments.

• Leads projects independently and adapts the plan as priorities, risks, and business conditions change.

Financial, Quality & Launch Accountability

• Owns product cost, tooling, capital, project spending, and the financial impact of project decisions.

• Drives closure of gaps to product performance, reliability, regulatory, quality, manufacturability, supplier readiness, and launch targets.

• Partners with Operations, Quality, Sourcing, Supply Chain, and suppliers to establish specifications and deliver conforming products.

• Ensures project decisions support scalable, sustainable production and a successful ramp-up.

Team Leadership & Executive Communication

• Creates alignment and accountability between cross functional project teams.

• Provides candid, concise executive updates that communicate status through the lens of outcomes, risks, trade-offs, decisions, and support needed.

• Builds trust, resolves conflict, and maintains team momentum in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.

• Coaches project team members and reinforces strong project leadership practices.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor of Science in an engineering discipline or a closely related technical field.

• Minimum 5 years, preferred 8 years of relevant engineering, product development, manufacturing, or technical project leadership experience.

• Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product development projects of moderate to high complexity.

• Advanced capability in integrated scheduling, risk management, product costing, technical trade-offs, and launch execution.

• Ability to influence across functions, resolve misalignment, and communicate effectively with senior leadership.

• Strong technical aptitude and working knowledge of materials, manufacturing processes, product validation, and supplier development.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with outdoor power equipment, power tools, consumer products, batteries/chargers, or electromechanical systems.

• Experience leading global NPD programs through concept, design, validation, certification, tooling, pilot, and launch.

• Experience with DFMEA, DVP&R, DFM/DFA, PPAP, cost modeling, and project scheduling tools.

• Demonstrated coaching or mentoring of project engineers and cross-functional team members.

Travel

• Up to 15% travel (international and domestic).

Job Description:

TTI Floor Care North America is hiring an AP / Treasury Analyst. We are a high growth, market leader looking for energetic and curious individuals who will thrive in a fast-paced environment.  We offer competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package - tuition assistance, 401(k), medical/dental/vision coverage, vacation (Paid Time Off) and holidays. This role is based out of Anderson, SC and will report to the AP/ AR Manager II.

The AP / Treasury Analyst role will perform daily tasks to support the Treasury cash management function to ensure a continuous monitoring of the group’s cash position. They will be a key interface with many other business groups including Marketing, Human Resources, IT, Legal and other groups within Finance.  The Analyst will participate in on-going process improvement efforts and special projects designed to enhance our capabilities.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Prepare daily reconciliations of bank accounts and related G/L accounts.

• Support month-end cash management processes for financial closing.

• Prepare cash and liability reconciliations for interim and year-end financial audits.

• Prepare deposits for all companies.

• Review and validate the set up and maintenance of new vendors/suppliers in Oracle following Corporate and IRS guidelines relating to W9, W8s and related documents.

• Enter and process vendor invoices in ERP; maintain accurate vendor invoice history.

• Communicate effectively with vendors and other employees to resolve payment processing issues.

• Prepare monthly Accounts Payable closing reports.

• Manage & reconcile corporate credit cards and employee expense reports.

• Assist Accounts Payable team with year-end audit requests and 1099 reporting.

• Complete additional projects and duties as delegated by department management.

Requirements:

• Detail-oriented with strong analytical and organizational skills and commitment to quality, accuracy, and problem-solving ability.

• Organized, flexible, self-starter with ability to take leadership initiative; strong drive and follow through.

• Team-oriented with ability to interact with all levels of employees in a professional and positive manner

• Strong customer service focus and communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills

• Must be available to work in the office full-time and beyond normal business hours, if required

Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting

• Work experience 2+ years preferred.

• Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Outlook required

• Experience operating in an ERP system is preferred (SAP, Oracle, JDE, etc.)
